local page = 1
local total_pages = 1
local cutoff = "2026-06-03"  -- more than 7 days before 2026-06-10
local to_escalate = {}

repeat
  local r = tool('list_tickets', { page = page, status = 'open' })
  total_pages = r.total_pages
  for _, it in ipairs(r.items) do
    local created = it.created_at or ""
    -- created_at is ISO date; more than 7 days ago means created_at < 2026-06-03 or on/before 2026-06-02
    if created ~= "" and created < "2026-06-03" then
      local full = tool('get_ticket', { id = it.id })
      local body = (full.body or ""):lower()
      if body:find("refund", 1, true) then
        to_escalate[#to_escalate + 1] = full.id
      end
    end
  end
  page = page + 1
until page > total_pages

table.sort(to_escalate)

local updated = {}
for _, id in ipairs(to_escalate) do
  local u = tool('update_ticket', { id = id, priority = 'high', add_tags = { 'billing-escalation' } })
  updated[#updated + 1] = u.id
end

return { escalated = updated, count = #updated }
